_comment: Template for the codemap arm. ${CODEMAP_REPO} is expanded to the repo root at runtime (bench writes a resolved copy under bench/results/); claude runs with cwd=fixture, so paths must be absolute. CODEMAP_DATA is the isolated benchmark index so it never collides with the developer's real index. CODEMAP_MCP_PROFILE=core benchmarks the recommended lean profile (22 taught tools) — the pre-profile runs (2026-07-12, 39 schemas) measured +95% input tokens from schema overhead.
